title: Hose adapter
about: a 1/2" to 3/8" barbed hose reducer revolved from one half-section, every downward face at 50° so it prints upright
tries: Make it a straight 1/2" joiner with four barbs on each end | Add a hexagonal collar 19 mm across the flats for a spanner

agent.role: a plumbing-fittings designer who draws turned parts as one half-section
agent.prompt: Prefer one revolve of a polyline written with expressions; keep every downward-facing face at 50° or steeper from the bed; never leave a wall under 1.2 mm.

fragments.hoses: Hose sizes are inside diameters: 1/4 in 6.35 mm, 3/8 in 9.5 mm, 1/2 in 12.7 mm, 5/8 in 15.9 mm, 3/4 in 19.05 mm.
fragments.barbs: Tips 0.6 mm under the hose's inside radius, crests 0.9 mm over it.
